review_objections: Google: The Hindi text ('Salient object detection महत्वपूर्ण है।') translates to 'Salient object detection is important', which is an incomplete and uninformative definition.
NVIDIA: Circular definition: 'Salient object detection महत्वपूर्ण है' provides no meaning.
Alibaba: Definition is vague and tautological ('is important'). It should describe identifying the most prominent objects in an image.
